animations.name: Medium Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE slow, deliberate crouching open-palm strike across the clip (strictly one strike only, never a jab first or second strike), pure body motion only in empty air: staying anchored low on the baseline without standing up, he winds up by rotating his shoulders back and drawing his right hand back near his chest; then he smoothly twists forward and thrusts ONE powerful horizontal open-palm strike straight right (right arm extended, palm open facing right, left elbow pulled back behind his torso); brief hold at full reach, then smooth retraction back into the starting crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, cap, navy sweater, jeans, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
